name: SRTM 30m (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission)
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84 geographic), heights referenced to EGM96
labels: Surface elevation (DSM). Radar-derived; includes vegetation and buildings.
license: Public domain (US government work). Freely downloadable.
provenance: NASA EarthExplorer or USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center. No registration required for download.
limitations: 2000 vintage — does not reflect post-2000 construction. 30m resolution insufficient for building-level analysis. Radar voids in steep terrain and water bodies. Layover artefacts in dense urban areas. Significant age limitation for change detection use. Use for terrain baseline only.
intended_use: Task 3 (terrain baseline / fallback DEM), Task 2 (pipeline compatibility testing)
